stemMd: Which form of $6x^2-13x-5$ makes its zeros easiest to identify?
explanationMd: The products of the outer and inner terms are −15x and 2x, summing to −13x; the constant is −5. The correct factors show zeros −1/3 and 5/2 directly.

distractorRationale.b: This gives a positive 13x middle term.
